payload._note: No customer concentration disclosed. The 10-K states RGP engaged with over 2,000 clients in fiscal 2023 including over 87% of the Fortune 100, and discusses a Strategic Client Account program for largest clients and an 80% retention rate of top 100 clients over 5 years. However, no specific named customers or revenue percentages are disclosed. The filing mentions the top 100 clients but does not provide revenue concentration data for the top 1, 5, or 10 customers. The business model is clearly project-based consulting rather than recurring revenue, with services rendered on a time-and-materials or fixed-price project basis.
